title: "Stop whining about the war. Start wielding the Word."
paragraphs: "Stop whining about the war. Start wielding the Word."
Spiritual battle tip: Complaints don’t cut demons. Scripture does.
“Take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.”
This verse is the literal foundation of the “wield the Word” imagery — Paul’s teaching that Scripture itself is the believer’s weapon in spiritual battle.
